title: Road Hazard Protection Puncture Repair Terms
content:
**Free repair.** Under Road Hazard Protection a covered puncture that can be safely repaired is repaired free; a tire that cannot be repaired is replaced under the plan's replacement terms.

**When a puncture is repairable.** A puncture is repairable only when all of the following hold:
- it is a tread puncture in the plan's repairable zone (the tread area);
- it is no larger than the plan's largest repairable puncture;
- the tire's remaining tread is above the plan's minimum tread for repair.

A shoulder puncture, a sidewall cut, an impact break or bead damage is never repaired.

**What the repair includes.** The repair uses the plan's repair method, the patch-plug combination, including dismount, patch-plug, remount and balance, at no charge.

**Per-position limit.** The number of repairs booked on the certificate for the same wheel position, including this repair, may not exceed the plan's covered repairs per wheel position. A further puncture on that position after the limit is handled as a replacement when the plan still has a replacement for the position, and otherwise is repaired at the store's regular price outside the plan.

**Booking.** Each repaired position under one claim number is its own repair entry.

| Damage found | Size and tread within limits | Handling |
|---|---|---|
| tread puncture | yes | free repair while the position's repair limit is not exceeded |
| tread puncture | no | not repairable; replaced under the replacement terms |
| shoulder puncture, sidewall cut, impact break, bead damage | (not relevant) | never repaired |

*Hypothetical limit case.* On a plan allowing 3 covered repairs per position, a position with 2 repairs already booked can have a third free repair; a fourth puncture on that position goes to a replacement if the position still has one, and otherwise is repaired at the store's regular price.
